title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a District Hospital in the Municipality of Santa Elena, Province of Camarines Norte and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of a District Hospital in the Municipality of Santa Elena, Province of Camarines Norte and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Bệnh viện Huyện tại Thị trấn Santa Elena, Tỉnh Camarines Norte, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงพยาบาลอำเภอในเทศบาล Santa Elena จังหวัด Camarines Norte และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้

title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Hospital Daerah di Perbandaran Santa Elena, Wilayah Camarines Norte, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2019/ra_11195_2019.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: - There shall be established a district hospital in the Municipality of Santa Elena, Province of Camarines Norte to be known as the Santa Elena District Hospital.

- The Provincial Government of Camarines Norte shall provide funding for the establishment, operation and maintenance of the Santa Elena District Hospital. The Secretary of Health shall include in the Department's subsidy program, support for the capital outlay of the said district hospital.
- This act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
